elements.requirement: A failure to comply with the first, second or third requirement constitutes a failure to comply with a duty to make reasonable adjustments.
elements.quote: A failure to comply with the first, second or third requirement is a failure to comply with a duty to make reasonable adjustments.

elements.requirement: A person (A) discriminates against a disabled person if A fails to comply with the duty to make reasonable adjustments in relation to that disabled person.
elements.quote: A discriminates against a disabled person if A fails to comply with that duty in relation to that person.

elements.requirement: A provision of an applicable Schedule that imposes a duty to comply with the first, second or third requirement applies only for the purpose of establishing whether a person (A) has contravened the Act by virtue of subsection (2).

elements.requirement: A failure to comply with a duty imposed by an applicable Schedule to comply with the first, second or third requirement is not actionable by virtue of another provision of the Act or otherwise.
